theses.name: AI-native back office
theses.description: Entire professional-services functions (accounting, legal, GTM ops, government affairs) rebuilt as agent-run operations rather than tools that assist humans.

theses.name: Agent infrastructure / AI devops
theses.description: Plumbing for other agents: file systems, observability, hosting, identity, pricing, cost-routing built specifically for autonomous agents.

theses.name: Agent security & identity
theses.description: A new security stack purpose-built for autonomous agents: authentication, vulnerability discovery, compliance, and governance for agent credentials/permissions.

theses.name: Physical AI / robotics economics
theses.description: Cost-down and verification/evaluation infrastructure for robotics — making robot deployment reliable and cheap enough for SMB adoption, not just mega-fleets.

theses.name: Defense-tech & autonomous systems
theses.description: Drone swarms, counter-UAS, low-cost strike manufacturing, and dual-use autonomy now treated as mainstream fundable categories.

theses.name: Vertical AI-native operating systems
theses.description: The 'Toast for X' playbook repeated for unsexy SMB verticals with messy paper/ops: auto shops, hotels, restaurants, wholesale distributors, dental, field service.

theses.name: Compute & energy scarcity
theses.description: Financialization of compute (GPU-hour trading/liquidity) and novel power generation for data centers as AI demand outstrips supply.

theses.name: Frontier bio/materials re-platformed on AI
theses.description: Foundation-model style approaches to chemistry, materials, and biology discovery, with proprietary experimental data as the moat.

theses.name: Contrarian consumer
theses.description: Consumer is starved of capital and unfashionable right now, which may make it a less crowded place to hunt for an outlier consumer bet.

theses.name: Financial-services decision infrastructure
theses.description: Agents deployed against underwriting, claims, and research decisioning in insurance and capital markets, where human-in-the-loop cost is high and decisions are structured.
